data.description: Engineers with NASA’s Exploration Ground Systems integrate the aerodynamic nose cone onto the left forward motor segment on the twin SLS (Space Launch System) solid rocket boosters for Artemis III inside the Vehicle Assembly Building’s High Bay 3 at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida on Tuesday, Sept. 29, 2026.
